question: {"question": "Does every command with status 0 (read, write, status, start, stop) count as carried out?", "proposed_default": "Yes, every accepted command with status 0 increments commands carried out."}
{"question": "Does a packet refused with status 3 or 5 count as carried out?", "proposed_default": "No, it counts only in the type/length/register/access error counter and in refused packets."}
{"question": "Which counter counts an old sequence number (more than 32767 behind) versus a repeated one?", "proposed_default": "Difference 0 is repeated; difference 32768 to 65535 is out-of-order."}
{"question": "Is the first telemetry frame due on the period-th tick after start?", "proposed_default": "Yes, the first frame falls due on the period-th tick after start."}
{"question": "What does TIMEOUT_CYCLES do?", "proposed_default": "Shell receive timeout in clocks, not used by the endpoint logic."}
